<!--
Before filing, please read https://github.com/rusefi/rusefi/wiki/LLM-policy

- When in doubt, go the https://github.com/rusefi/rusefi/wiki/Support route first.
- Lead with the underlying problem, not your proposed solution: https://xyproblem.info/
- Put the most important thing first: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/BLUF_(communication)
- LLM forensics and source-level findings are PROHIBITED in the ticket description -
  post them as a comment after filing. Humans are the bottleneck: walls of
  LLM-generated text get contributors blocked.
-->

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Start here - the problem, not the solution. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Would we need new configuration fields?**
List new settings for the proposed feature

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. Detailed analysis
and any LLM-assisted findings go in a *comment* on this issue, not here.

See also https://github.com/rusefi/technical-and-legacy/blob/main/Business-Analysis-Technical-Requirements.md
